story: In the diverse world of birds, the Sri Lanka Grey Hornbill (Psilopogon flavifrons) stands out. This species, part of the Megalaimidae family, is a resident of subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest;subtropical or tropical moist montane forest. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Sri Lanka Grey Hornbill is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Sri Lanka Grey Hornbill and its role in the ecosystem.
